scope: Frozen V5 seed42 identity-heldout development; no trained ablation or official-test inference
limits: 00 is V5-trained base, not separately trained DeMo. Four-state fixed-checkpoint interventions are not trained ablations, causal effects or information-theoretic synergy. Contributions use fixed development references and may differ from train-batch targets. Missing baselines reused at unchanged original masks; different host numerical order can affect near ties. Per-condition +2 count is an extra diagnostic, not replacement acceptance.
